shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a smartphone screen showing an app home interface with colorful rounded icons and a bright gradient background, a thumb hovering just above the glass, static handheld framing, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
shots.prompt_zh: 智能手机屏幕特写镜头，展示带有彩色圆形图标和明亮渐变背景的应用主界面，一根拇指悬停在玻璃屏幕上方，手持固定取景。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the same smartphone screen as a thumb taps a circular button, the interface transitions to a new panel with a progress bar animating across the top, soft ambient room light reflecting faintly on the glass, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
shots.prompt_zh: 同一部智能手机屏幕的特写镜头，拇指点击一个圆形按钮，界面切换到新的面板，顶部有进度条动画滑动，环境光在玻璃屏幕上有轻微反光。

shots.camera_note: static locked camera, centered card composition
shots.prompt_en: A plain solid mint-green card standing upright against a soft neutral backdrop, a wide blank rectangular panel centered on the card, gentle diffused lighting, static locked camera, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
shots.prompt_zh: 一张薄荷绿纯色卡片竖立在柔和的中性背景前，卡片中央是一块空白的矩形区域，柔和的漫射光，固定机位。

visual_forms.prompt_en: Close-up of a smartphone screen displaying a colorful app interface with rounded icons and animated panel transitions, a thumb interacting with the glass, soft ambient light reflecting faintly on the screen, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
visual_forms.prompt_zh: 智能手机屏幕特写镜头，展示带圆角图标和动态面板切换的彩色应用界面，一根拇指在玻璃屏幕上操作，环境柔光在屏幕上有轻微反光。

visual_forms.prompt_en: A plain solid-color card standing upright against a soft neutral backdrop, a wide blank rectangular panel centered on the card, gentle diffused lighting, static locked camera, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
visual_forms.prompt_zh: 一张纯色卡片竖立在柔和的中性背景前，卡片中央是一块空白的矩形区域，柔和的漫射光，固定机位。

slot_template.template_en: Close-up of a smartphone screen with {ICON_STYLE} on a {BACKDROP}, {INTERACTION} as the interface responds, cutting to a plain {CARD_COLOR} card with a blank centered panel, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
slot_template.template_zh: 智能手机屏幕特写镜头，{BACKDROP}上展示{ICON_STYLE}，{INTERACTION}并引发界面响应，随后切换到一张纯{CARD_COLOR}卡片，卡片中央为空白面板。

slots.name: INTERACTION
slots.observed_value: a thumb tapping a circular button
candidates: a thumb tapping a circular button

invariants.description: Same smartphone device and app interface visual style appears in both screen recording shots
Soft ambient lighting with gentle reflections is consistent across the screen recording shots

observed_values: close on a single button interaction

meta.note: 合成样例，用于 100x-video-reverse 的 schema/公理校验测试。App 界面、卡片内容均为虚构，不对应任何真实 App 或真实品牌。target_model=generic（未指名引擎，按公理2落最严档 8.0s 上限）。3 镜头覆盖 screen_recording + text_card 两种画面形态。text_card 那一镜刻意只描述卡片的纯色/留白构图，不写任何可读文字内容——一是因为 text/caption/title/letter/word/overlay/font/logo 本身就在21个禁词表内，二是因为公理3强制所有 prompt_en 都以 'no text, no subtitles, no watermarks' 收尾，这条 prompt 从措辞和语义上都必须回避描述可读文字，真实生产流程里可读文字通常是后期另外加上的。
